```{r}

# Create residual plot (resid vs fitted) of the model

if(metaecosystem_analysis == TRUE){
  
  res_vs_fit = create.res.vs.fit.metaecos(best_model)
  
}

if(patch_analysis == TRUE){
  
  res_vs_fit = create.res.vs.fit.patches(best_model)
  
}

res_vs_fit
qqnorm(resid(best_model))
```
